title: Rules-text words
description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card, paired by ability_id with the card's structure.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The words of that ability as printed in this language. For an activated ability, the words after the cost's colon (CR 602.1a): the card holds the cost, and the printed symbol for it is assembled from the card (CR 107.7 for the loyalty symbol).
